verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs show mechanisms relevant to retention/deletion control — Soft Delete/History/Live sync modes, 'capture deletes' per connector, data blocking/column hashing, row filtering, and an MCP server scope that can be set to 'read/write/delete' for delete operations. However, there's no explicit documentation of a data-retention policy, configurable retention windows, or a formal deletion/erasure workflow for compliance purposes (e.g., GDPR-style purge). Missing for 10: explicit data retention policy/configuration, documented data purge/erasure workflow, independent verification of deletion behavior.
